svg.title: Cointegration without correlation
svg.desc: Cointegration without correlation. A = X + u; B = X - u | X: random walk; u: independent white noise. First-difference correlation: population 0.000000, sample -0.047425. Stationary spread: A - B = 2u. Var(dX) = 1; Var(u) = 0.5. Cov(dA, dB) = 1 - 2(0.5) = 0. Synthetic observations, not market prices; stationarity follows from construction, not visual inspection.
